g.text: Ticket PR Loop - Fixes, Rechecks and Merge Conditions
Verify PR head/base match Ticket Branch/Base
Status: in_review; persist canonical PR link
First full PR; bounded fixes may be incremental
Full logs + base/head identity + execution status
See review-execution.svg for exact recovery behavior
Verify previous findings + latest test evidence
Keep same Ticket branch and PR
Record cause + logs + resume stage; Issue stays open
Never treat timeout, exit 0 or missing output as pass
Recorded review pass + required checks passed
PR head still equals reviewed head
Merge PR; verify MERGED and exact refs
Return to Slice loop before publishing
Arrows resume only the recorded failed stage;
Restore in_review when the existing PR is ready for review.
No Issue is closed merely because code was pushed.
PR/metadata cause resolved; query before create
review cause resolved; inspect saved run first
affected tests fail; diagnose and correct
affected tests pass; publish batch once
Slice loop and Ticket acceptance pass again
head/base changed; choose valid coverage again
